args.title: Re-enable the export button on export failure
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Add a .catch() callback to the exportReport promise chain in handleClick to ensure setBusy(false) is called when the export fails, preventing the button from remaining permanently disabled.

label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The exportReport promise chain in handleClick lacks a .catch() callback, so setBusy(false) is never called on rejection, leaving the export button permanently disabled.
